summary: A horizontal progress bar filling its width: a rounded track with a fill of progress × width (progress 0..1, a number or a variable).

progress.doc: 0..1; a number, a "@variable" or an expression; a change eases over 0.3 s (the bar or arc; a literal costs nothing)

height.doc: Bar thickness in dp; the ends are fully rounded

pitfalls: clamp takes (min, max, value): clamp(0, 1, @pa). clamp(@progress, 0, 1) is always 0 (the RPN is min max value CLAMP)
It fills its parent's width (componentWidth()): in a row put it in a weighted box, or it has no width
The fill is at least a round dot (max(height, width × progress)), so 0 % is not empty

A progress change animates: the drawing reads an animated local pa = {"value": "@progress", "anim": 0.3} (paint time). A literal progress folds to a number, so a static bar costs nothing extra; a value driven every frame just follows 0.3 s behind. Mono themes jump
